content: Biniyaame Zaretas Maccas Koshshu
Isra7eele asay Mixiphpha geetettizason shiiqida wode, «Nu giddofe ooninne Biniyaame asaas ba macca naa machcho immontta mala» giidi caaqetti uttides.
Isra7eeleti Beetele katamaa biidi heen sa7ay qammana gakkanaas Xoossa sinththan uttida; bantta qaalaakka dhoqqu histtidi camo yeeho yeekkida.
«Abeet GODAA Isra7eele Xoossawu, ha yo7oy ays Isra7eelen hanidee? Hach Isra7eele asaa giddofe issi zarey ays paccidee?» gida.
Wonteththa gallas maalado wonttara istti dendidi, yarsho yarshizaso heen giigsidi xuugettiza yarshotanne issifeteththa yarshota shiishshida.

Histtidi Isra7eeleti, «Isra7eele zare ubbaafe GODAA sinththan shiiqizaso yontta attida zarey oonee?» giidi oychchida. Istti hessa oychchida gaasoykka Mixiphpha kataman GODAA sinththan shiiqanaas yontta attida asi oonikka, «Izi mulera hayqqo» giidi kase caaqqida gishshassa.
Isra7eele asay bantta ishatas, Biniyaame qommotas qadhettidi, «Hach Isra7eeleppe issi qommoy dhaydes.
Nuni nu macca nayta isttas immontta mala GODAAN caaqqida gishshas hayqoppe attida Biniyaame qommoti machcho demmana mala nuni ay ooththanee?» gida.
Qasseka isttas, «Isra7eele qommotappe Mixiphpha kataman GODAA sinth yonttay oonee?» giidi oychchida. Be7ite! Gala7aaden diza Yaabuse geetettiza katamappe issaadeyka shiiqo yonttayssa erite.
Istti asaa qoodida wode Gala7aaden diza Yaabuseppe issi asikka beettibeenna.
Hessa gishshas maabaray 12,000 mino olanchchata Gala7aaden diza Yaabuse katama kiittidi, «Biite; biidi Yaabusen dizayta ubbaa giththa mashshan busakkite; maccassaka guuththa naytakka ashshofte.
Histtite addenne adde gelida maccassa ubbaa wodhite» giidi azazida.
Yaabuse katamaan diza asaa ubbaa 400 geela7ota demmida; isttika Kanaane biittan, Seelo geetettiza guta ekki ehida.
Hessafe guye kumeththa maabaray Ermoone zaalla geetettizason diza Biniyaame qommotakko sigettanaas kiita yeddida.
Biniyaame qommoti simmidi yida; Isra7eele asay Yaabuse katamappe wodhontta ehida geela7ota isttas immides. Gido attiin geela7ota qooday guuth gidida gishshas attuma asaa gakkibeenna.
GODAY Isra7eele zereththa giddon diza issifeteththay duuxxana mala ooththida gishshas asay Biniyaame asaas keehippe qadhettides.
Dere cimati, «Biniyaame qommotappe maccassi hayqqi wurida gishshas hayqoppe attida attuma asaas nuni maccas wostti demmanee?
Isra7eele asaa giddofe issi qommoy dhoommi dhayontta mala, Biniyaame qommotappe attidaytas laattizay daanaas bessees.
Gidikkonne nuni nu macca naytappe isttas immanaas dandayokko; ays giikko Isra7eele asay kase, ‹Ba nayo Biniyaame qommos immiza asi qanggettidaade gido› giidi caaqetti uttides» gida.

Hessafe guye dere kaaleththiza cimati, «Be7ite, layththan layththan Seelon GODAA bonchchiza ba7aaley matides» gida. Seeloy Beeteleppe pudeha baggara, Laboonappe dugeha baggara Beeteleppe Seekeeme giddora efiza ogeppe arshe kessa baggara dees.
He deraa kaaleththiza cimati Biniyaame qommota, «Biite; biidi woyne tura giddon qotetti uttite!
Naagite! Seelo katama macca nayti ba7aale gallas karabe oykkidi yexxishenne durishe yishin intte woyne tura giddofe kezite. Ubbayka Seelo macca naytappe inttes dafidi Biniyaame biitta ekki biite.

Istta aawati woykko istta ishati nuukko magannanaas yiza wode nuni isttas, ‹Ha7i hayyana! Istta nuus immite; ays giikko nuni istta hu7en hu7en gakkiza maccassa ola sohoppe demmibeekko; intte dosan immontta gishshas mooranchcha gidekketa› gaana» gida.

Biniyaame qommotikka Isra7eele cimati gida mala ooththida; ubbayka Seelon yexxiza macca naytappe bantta qooda keena dafi efida. Istti bantta laata biittaa simmidi katamata woththi keexxidi heen de7ida.
He wode Isra7eele asay heeppe laalettidi ubbayka ba qommoko qommokonne baso asaakko asaakko bides.
He wode Isra7eele biittan kawoy baawa; asi ubbay baas lo7o misati beettoyssa coo ooththees.
